The '''Queen of Zygerria''' was the title held by a [[Gender/Legends|female]] ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Miraj Scintel/Legends|Miraj Scintel]] held the title.
